They were already divorced for three years, and Sarah didn’t have a good memory of the man. If she could… she would have let him die. However, she was a doctor, and a doctor's job was to save patients.
Sarah immediately regretted her decision to save the man because it turned out that Michael had amnesia and remembered that they just got married!
To make matters worse, she stupidly accepted her ex-in-law's request to pretend to remain Michael's wife while taking care of him. Why did she do that?
However… during the time she spent with her ex-husband, Michael's attitude was very different from what Sarah had last remembered. He was very gentle… and loving. It made the feelings she thought were gone, come up to the surface.
Would Sarah be able to deal with her feelings? What would happen when Michael's memory suddenly returned? Would his attitude stay the same?

When Ryujin wakes up in the video game he use to play, Espers of the World, he quickly realizes something terrifying: this isn’t a game anymore—it’s reality.
Stripped of his identity and renamed Kaidren, he must now survive as a low-profile orphan with a mysterious past and a future controlled only by power. The world around him mirrors the game’s setting, yet the rules are no longer bound by code. The television works. The phone updates in real time. Events that never occurred in the original storyline unfold before his eyes.
The NPCs? They’re real people now—with real emotions, real consequences, and real power.
As Kaidren struggles to adapt, he’s haunted by memories of a trauma-stricken life and an overwhelming detachment from emotion.
But the deeper he explores this so-called game world, the clearer it becomes—this reality is unpredictable, unscripted, and far more dangerous than he ever imagined. And to stay alive, he’ll have to confront what it means to be human... and what it means to be powerful.
Because in this world, the line between player and pawn no longer exists.
superman-termination-manual:
Ke Mingye accidentally gained the ability to read identities and soon discovered that his family members were an extremely complex mix. Seemingly ordinary family members each had their own secret identities:
—— “Superheroes,” “magical girls,” “ninjas,” “aliens,” “vampires,” “employee of Anomaly Control Bureau ,” “dragonkin,” “diviners”...
Day and night, each family member tried their best to keep their secret identity hidden, so they made their days extraordinarily mysterious, behaving as normal as possible in front of anyone.
But the identities they desperately concealed were nothing more than a string of data on the player panel to Ke Mingye.
Just when Ke Mingye was lamenting that there wasn’t a single normal person in his family, he received a main quest from the game system...
—— “Eradicate the Superhumans.”
“Eradicate... the superhumans?”
Sitting at the dining table, Ke Mingye was stunned for a long time, with his chopsticks in his mouth, as he turned his head to survey the room full of superhumans and thought to himself that this was pretty a “happy” surprise！XD
the-legendary-masters-wife:
After an explosion, You XiaoMo finds that he is now a probationary disciple of the TianXin sect. However, he is one with dubious potential, so just when he starts to adapt to his new circumstances, he receives a piece of bad news. If he is unable to produce the required result after half a year to become an official disciple of the TianXin sect, he would be driven out of the sect.
While You XiaoMo is going all out to make medicines and earn money, he runs into Ling Xiao. To his horror, he later discovers that Ling Xiao is actually someone cloaked in human skin.
the-lunar-crest-academy-marked-by-the-ly:
#WARNING
Vivid descriptions of abuse scenes.
Readers discretion is advised.
They call it an honor, but everyone knows the truth.
Every year, the Lycans choose one werewolf from the Feral Packs to attend Lunar Crest Academy. A place of wealth, power, and deadly secrets. A place no Feral has ever returned from.
This year, that sacrifice is Lorraine Anderson
Branded as the outcast of the ShadowFang Pack, she has endured years of torment at the hands of those who once called her family. Beaten, broken, and betrayed, she is now being handed over to the monsters that rule them all. The Lycans.
She knows what awaits her.....death.
But when she arrives at Lunar Crest Academy, she finds something even worse than death. A game.
One where she is the lowest-ranked player.
One where survival is impossible.
And at the center of it all stands him.
The Lycan prince. Cold. Ruthless. Dangerous. His red eyes seem to follow her every move, his presence a constant, suffocating force. She should fear him like everyone else. She should cower under his gaze.
But she doesn’t.
Because beneath his terrifying exterior, there’s something else. Something dark and possessive.…
the-lupine-system:
Mike never had any grand aspirations.
Growing up in the outer settlements of Klein 4, all he'd ever known was scavenging for scraps and living to see the next day. All he wanted was a comfortable life.
But fate had other plans, and in a grand turn of events, he acquired the Lupine system. It all happened so fast, and the next thing he knew, he was thrust into a war with another race known as the Lizardmen, all the while, he tries to keep his true nature under wraps.
A world where might makes right, and death is always looming around the corner, Join Mike as he tries to navigate this strange reality with a system that seemed to have turned him into a werewolf.
the-omniversal-merchant:
In the heart of the Azure Continent lies a legendary establishment known as Origin Mall.
This extraordinary store offers goods beyond imagination: a sip of its cola can instantly replenish one's vitality; its spicy snacks grant the strength to overcome powerful foes; the games it offers can accelerate cultivation progress; and its novels impart profound techniques and insights.
Origin Mall boasts a vast array of offerings, catering to leisure, entertainment, dining, and training needs alike.
However, there’s one rule that all visitors must remember: never cause trouble in the store. The owner, though unassuming, is unimaginably powerful.
transcending-10000-daos-bl:
Yu Nianzhen and Jiang Yue were born on the same day of the same month and year. They went to the same schools, lived the same life, and then they kissed!
Three years later, they transmigrated to a world of cultivation. In this new world, Yu Nianzhen and Jiang Yue were determined to be together and transcend the highest peak.
This novel isn't a slow burn by any definition of the term. Romance will start within the first fifty chapters.

transmigrated-into-one-piece-world-with-:
An ordinary soul from Earth mysteriously transmigrates into One Piece World. What's more, he was presented with a Gift Pack from God.
Follow his journey, from being a slave to an extraordinary existence that everyone fears.

twisted-dreams:
Li Yang obtains a Magic Jar that can fulfill desires.
But the way it fulfills desires is horrifying....
A disfigured Female Streamer wants to become beautiful and turns into an enchanting Enchanting Demon.
A man seriously injured while saving someone wishes not to die and becomes an immortal Vampire.
A Daoist of a Daoist Temple that was demolished wants to learn magic and becomes a Hell Sorcerer proficient in Techniques.
Everyone's desires are fulfilled in a twisted way.

Reincarnated twice and betrayed in every life, Cale Regulus Midgar thought his luck had finally changed when he woke up as the son of a powerful Duke. But his sixth stepmother had other plans—she locked him underground, using his dragon bloodline to breed monsters for a year.
Until a corrupt god offered him a second chance.
The price? Eternal nightmares that may or may not come true. The reward? The Supreme Intimacy Bloodline System—a cheat that transforms every seduction into power.
Through the Lust Bond, women become permanently obsessed with him, unable to find satisfaction with anyone else. Through Bloodline Absorption, he gains their power, their traits, their very essence. The purer they are, the easier they fall.…
wandering-gods-of-day-and-night:
The ancient Buddha's head was stolen by a monster with a human body and a sheep's head.
The Ghost buried an eye in the Buddha's temple, and from then on, the world's fire was extinguished, and darkness engulfed the continent.
To combat the Ghost' invasion, the gods of day and night were born between heaven and earth.
This is a narrative passed down for generations by storytellers.
What was the true nature of the ancient Buddha, the Ghost, and the wandering gods of day and night on the once great continent?
Perhaps, traces can be found in a troupe named 'Zhou Family Troupe.'
The Zhou Family Troupe,
is a troupe that performs operas specifically for the dead...
wealthy-beauty-in-the-60s:
Xia Xiao unexpectedly reincarnates to the 1960s and becomes a young intellectual in a production team.
Having obtained a mystical space with a spirit spring and jade water, she raises chickens and grows vegetables, but dares not use them.
As everyone around her is skinny and hungry, if she turns herself into a wealthy and beautiful woman, it would lead to her undoing.
Xia Xiao looks up to the sky and sighs deeply, what a bittersweet surprise this is!
witchbound-my-power-grows-with-every-tri:
Ren has never known kindness. He grew up alone in the slums, learning to survive by staying out of sight and trusting no one. One night, he stumbles into a strange tunnel and finds a hidden shrine forgotten by time.
There, he sees a black cat with golden eyes and hears a voice inside his head.
The shrine is more than it seems. So is the cat.
As Ren is pulled into something ancient and mysterious, he must decide if he's willing to take a different step in life or keep running from the world that hurt him.
Because the city doesn't care if he lives or dies, but something in the dark might.
(No system, no isekai, no reincarnation, no regression, no harem. The story focuses on mystery and character development.)
